mapper.insert: insert into overdue_fine(reader_name, book_title, overdue_days, fine_amount, payment_status) values(#{readerName}, #{bookTitle}, #{overdueDays}, #{fineAmount}, #{paymentStatus})
mapper.update: update overdue_fine set reader_name = #{readerName}, book_title = #{bookTitle}, overdue_days = #{overdueDays}, fine_amount = #{fineAmount}, payment_status = #{paymentStatus} where id = #{id}
